title: Inter-Temporal Price Constraints in Dynamic Pricing: Performance Guarantees Under Price Monotonicity and Promotion Fatigue
summary: We study dynamic pricing problems under inter-temporal price constraints. We have resources with limited capacities. At each time period, we decide which products to make available and what prices to charge for the available products. The sale probability for a product depends on its price. If we make a sale for a product, then we collect a revenue reflecting the price and consume the capacities of a combination of resources. We work with two types of inter-temporal constraints.
